context: Re-run following IN-3502 scope fix (Noel Babu 2026-09-01). Confirms Practitioner.r + Practitioner.s + Location.r all honoured end-to-end against the HNZ-recommended stable UAT persona 91ZZWJ (HPI-P-Get-2 test persona per https://hpi-ig.hip-uat.digital.health.nz/PractitionerComplianceTesting.html).

scenarios.name: 1. Positive Get Practitioner
scenarios.purpose: Retrieve a known valid HPI-CPN (91ZZWJ) and confirm a well-formed Practitioner resource is returned.

response.body_excerpt_truncated: FHIR Practitioner resource returned (see prod DevTools capture for full body — Dr EMH, Starfleet Medical Academy test persona, MCNZ 99571, multiple qualifications and additional authorisations)

scenarios.name: 2. Not-Found Get Practitioner
scenarios.purpose: Query a non-existent CPN (ZZ9ZZZ) and confirm the product surfaces a 404 gracefully.

scenarios.name: 3. Malformed Input Handling
scenarios.purpose: Query with malformed CPN characters to confirm we do not leak stack traces and pass errors through as 4xx.

scenarios.name: 4. Search Practitioner by name
scenarios.purpose: Search for practitioners by name (Herling) and confirm a FHIR Bundle is returned with 0..n entries. HPI Practitioner search accepts the FHIR 'name' parameter (compound match against family + given).

scenarios.name: 5. Get Facility (Location) — structural + auth check
scenarios.purpose: Retrieve Location by id (G11238-E) to confirm the Location.r scope is honoured. Accepts a 200 or a well-formed 404 OperationOutcome (proves auth flow + endpoint routing + graceful error handling).

expected.description: 200 OK with FHIR Location resource — OR — 404 with OperationOutcome (both accepted)
